scoring_justification: Hartree frequencies are recomputed from scratch using the identical model; IU screening is verified structurally (longitudinal suppression). Full T1 recompute for IU is not required because the exact form of Ichimaru-Utsumi used by the agent may differ, but the direction of the effect is a robust signature of genuine implementation.

hidden_assets.purpose: Pure metal parameters (Z, Ω₀, kF, rC, M), PAA mixing rules, bcc shell generation, integration cut‑off (40kF, 33 shells), and the recompute logic for Hartree phonon frequencies. The Ichimaru-Utsumi correction form used for structural verification is q²/(2(q²+kF²)).
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper (DOI:10.1007/s11706-008-0039-z) for rC values; Cohen & Heine, Solid State Physics Vol. 24 (1970) for atomic volumes and valence; standard Lindhard function for ε_H; simplified IU variant consistent with many pseudopotential studies.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Hard‑coded constants from the referenced literature; shells generated from the bcc lattice; frequencies computed by numerical integration and diagonalisation.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: All values are traceable to published physical constants or the referenced paper’s own data. No arbitrary ground truth was invented.

schema.description: CSV containing phonon frequencies for all 9 materials (5 pure + 4 alloys), 3 high‑symmetry directions ([100], [110], [111]), 2 screening functions (H, IU), and 3 branches (L, T1, T2) per q‑point. At least 50 q‑points per direction per material per screening.

outputs.description: Main reproduction target: phonon dispersion frequencies computed using the Gajjar empty‑core pseudopotential with both Hartree and Ichimaru–Utsumi exchange‑correlation screening. The verifier recomputes frequencies independently and scores based on mean absolute percentage error against the number of materials and alloys.

output_contract.notes: The verifier will recompute frequencies using the same physical model with identical parameters and numerical cutoffs. Agreement is quantified by mean absolute percentage error (MAPE) across all reported entries, with a threshold‑based scoring policy. Additional structural checks may include ordering of longitudinal vs transverse branches and monotonic trends with atomic mass.

steps.description: Recompute Hartree phonon frequencies and verify IU longitudinal suppression. Score composed of Hartree MAPE (0.8) and IU structural compliance (0.2).
